values.note: Cash or check paid on arrival. No camping on Tuesday or Wednesday nights (ND Game and Fish Wildlife Management Area rule).

note: Williams County Parks camping area on McGregor Dam, a no-wake reservoir about 15 miles north of Tioga, with a boat ramp, fishing piers and a playground. Sites 1-6 on the north-east knoll and 10-17 on the south-west peninsula sit on open grass near the water. --Claude
summary: County page + 2024 county map: $15 electric / $10 primitive, cash or check, FCFS, 17 electric sites (20/30/50 A) in three groups, closed to camping Tue/Wed (WMA rule). Lakefront stands (sites 1-6 ~15-20 m, 10-17 ~35-50 m from the water over open grass). Pin ok. Phone suggestion from the county.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront stands. Sites 1-6 (north-east knoll, around 48.58518,-102.93170) are on open mown ground with an RV parked ~18 m from the west shore; sites 10-17 (back-in pads on the south-west peninsula, around 48.5823,-102.9387) end ~35-50 m from the north-west bay across open grass with a thin reed fringe. Both groups are sold by the night (FCFS). Stored evidence agrees.
